Pumping, Milk Storage & Returning to Work | IBCLC Tips for Busy Moms

Returning to work while breastfeeding? Wondering when to start pumping, how much milk to store, or how to build a freezer stash without creating an oversupply?
In this episode of the Momcozy Care Program, International Board Certified Lactation Consultant (IBCLC) and Certified Perinatal Mental Health Provider Lana Mihaiyu shares practical, evidence-based guidance to help you confidently navigate pumping, milk storage, and returning to work while continuing your breastfeeding journey.
Whether you're exclusively breastfeeding, combo feeding, or preparing to pump at work, this video covers realistic strategies to help you meet your feeding goals while protecting your milk supply and your well-being.
In this video, you'll learn:
• When to start pumping breast milk
• How to introduce a bottle while breastfeeding
• How to build a milk stash without ov
